tickets.title: Complete policy renewal follow-up checks
tickets.text:
Use this checklist for a policy renewal review:
- Confirm the policy type, carrier, owner, insured party, beneficiary, and renewal notice status.
- Request the current declarations page, premium notice, in-force illustration, or renewal packet as applicable.
- Compare current coverage, deductible, riders, exclusions, and premium changes against prior records.
- Ask whether household, business, debt, dependent, or risk exposure changes may affect coverage needs.
- Note whether the client should consult the insurance agent, attorney, or tax professional before making changes.
- Update the planning file with the reviewed documents and summarize any recommended next action. Obtain the current Amber Teapot Insurance declarations pages and renewal packet for Serena and Daniel Pebblefizz's homeowners and umbrella package, and confirm whether the coverage includes cyber fraud or identity-theft reimbursement.
tickets.evidence: Serena asked whether the homeowners and umbrella package includes cyber fraud or identity-theft reimbursement, and the current Amber Teapot Insurance declarations pages and renewal packet are not yet in the planning file. The agreed follow-up for those records is due 2024-09-05.
